autonomyMode.title: Delegate autonomy
autonomyMode.description: Sets how much freedom a connected delegate (Claude Code or Codex) gets by default when executing tools. Only applies once a delegate is connected, and for this device.
autonomyMode.standardDescription: Tool calls go through the same approval rule as every other model (Manual/Auto/Plan, adjustable in chat).
autonomyMode.ungatedDescription: The delegate runs fully on its own, using its own native full-autonomy mechanism — Holzi does not intervene or ask.
autonomyMode.gated_permissiveDescription: The delegate can act freely, but the deny rules set below stay off-limits — no prompts, every action is logged.
autonomyMode.saveFailed: Failed to save the autonomy default.
autonomyMode.loadFailed: Failed to load the autonomy default.

denyRules.title: Delegate deny rules
denyRules.description: Actions that stay off-limits for a connected delegate even under an otherwise autonomous mode — applies to this device.
denyRules.workspace_escapeDescription: Block file access outside the invocation's own workspace.
denyRules.network_accessDescription: Block actions that reach the network.
denyRules.credential_pathsDescription: Block access to common credential/secret file paths (.ssh, .aws, .env, …).
